query:
SELECT sponsorId, 
  CASE WHEN rankingsData LIKE '%91862579761%' THEN 'Callaghan FOUND' ELSE '' END as callaghan,
  CASE WHEN rankingsData LIKE '%21545051%' THEN 'Hulme FOUND' ELSE '' END as hulme,
  CASE WHEN rankingsData LIKE '%183232510638%' THEN 'Kennedy FOUND' ELSE '' END as kennedy,
  CASE WHEN rankingsData LIKE '%191181142545%' THEN 'Widdison FOUND' ELSE '' END as widdison
FROM rankingsSubmissions
WHERE rankingsData LIKE '%91862579761%' 
   OR rankingsData LIKE '%21545051%'
   OR rankingsData LIKE '%183232510638%'
   OR rankingsData LIKE '%191181142545%';
